title.en: Turn the code into an error

hints.en: Inside `try:` call `response.raise_for_status()`; in `except requests.HTTPError:` print the `failed` line and `continue`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"
paths = ["/books/5", "/books/0", "/authors/3", "/authors/42"]

for path in paths:
    response = requests.get(BASE + path)
    try:
        response.raise_for_status()
    except requests.HTTPError:
        print("failed", path, response.status_code)
        continue
    body = response.json()
    print("ok", path, body.get("title", body.get("name")))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"
paths = ["/books/5", "/books/0", "/authors/3", "/authors/42"]

for path in paths:
    response = requests.get(BASE + path)
    try:
        response.raise_for_status()
    except requests.HTTPError:
        print("failed", path, response.status_code)
        continue
    body = response.json()
    print("ok", path, body.get("title", body.get("name")))
```
